source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: As your Shooting phase starts, pick one enemy unit that is visible to and within 12" of Ephrael Stern in this unit. That enemy unit takes a Battle-shock test, with 2 subtracted from the result when it is CHAOS. If it fails, 3 mortal wounds are inflicted on that unit.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
